up: Retrieve exact IC50 activity values (standard_relation = '=' and standard_type = 'IC50') for compounds tested against human MMP-9 (target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL321'). Output columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, target_pref_name, target_organism, target_chembl_id. Join activities to assays (filter by target) and to docs (activities.doc_id = docs.doc_id). Use LEFT JOIN for compound_records (activities.record_id = compound_records.record_id), then join compound_records to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures. Filter: canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL AND (docs.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR docs.doi IS NOT NULL). For pubmed_id_or_doi, prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi. Return DISTINCT rows over the output columns.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, cr.compound_key, COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, ass.description AS assay_description, td.pref_name AS target_pref_name, td.organism AS target_organism, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL321' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL)
